newsitem.title: UK: EMS/Mark struggles on crosses as dlr/mark surges.
newsitem.headline: EMS/Mark struggles on crosses as dlr/mark surges.

text.p: 1250 GMT - Mark off lows on crosses but still soft, pressured by dollar/mark's rally to new 7-1/2 year high on stronger-than-expected U.S. jobs data.
* Dollar/mark breaches key 1.8500 level to high of 1.8570 after data shows U.S. July non-farm payrolls rose 316,000 vs forecast 193,000 but average hourly earnings stayed unchanged.

* Spanish Economy Minister Rato says 1998 public spending to rise 3.4 pct, deficit cutting clear priority. Says sees 1997 GDP growth at 3.2 pct and 3.4 in 1998, real growth in both years will be above inflation. Mark/peseta at 84.38/39 vs 84.45/46.
* Italian treasury minister Ciampi says July PSBR of 4.3 trln lire in line with govt goal to cut public deficit to 3.0 pct of GDP. Mark/lira at 975.85/05 vs 975.70/00.
* Mark/Paris at 3.3707/12 vs 3.3721/23 late Thursday. Mark/Swiss at 82.05/08 after slipping below 82.00 vs Thursday's 82.35/40.
